title: Ore Craft
description: This project adds new wonderful ores to your own world!
body:
This mod does something wonderfull to your game. It allows Minecrafts original ores like Iron, Copper, Diamond, Gold, and Netherite so get expanded upon in multiple different ways that still allows the game to feel vanilla and balanced.

This mod currently only adds Tin, but this will be added upon in updates that you can expect soon. Tin currently has Tin Ore, Tin Ingot, Tin Block, and Raw Tin. You have a recipe for it to go from Raw Tin to a Tin Ingot.

Although this mod seems small currently it will be expanded upon greatly! Have a good time while playing with this mod everyone!
